diagnostic: AddressSanitizer error-path validation after VM-stack page repair
remediation: All subsequent diagnostic, build, test and benchmark jobs run sequentially in a separate user-systemd service with aggregate MemoryMax=6G, MemorySwapMax=0, OOMPolicy=kill and KillMode=control-group. Verify inherited cgroup limits before any expensive work.
confirmed_growth_cause: The diagnostic source deliberately restored the old interface lookup. Hoa Event::register then recursively constructed Hoa Exception objects, whose constructors called Event::register again. A bounded native diagnostic captured 64 distinct frames with alternating calls.
follow_up_validation: Use runtime sources byte-for-byte equal to the candidate, compare full PHPStan output with PHP, and retain the independent ASan cross-page stack reproduction.
application_scope_evidence: The user-service journal records the enclosing desktop application scope failing with result oom-kill immediately after the kernel killed the diagnostic process.
